name: Crank
description: A crank throw: two journals joined by a web, set over at whatever angle the engine wants.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; top: 30%; width: 56%; height: 40%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 62%; top: 34%; width: 32%; height: 32%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 46%, #000 46%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 46%, #000 46%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
